personas.name: routine-carpal-tunnel-nerve-conduction-complete
personas.description: Well-formed routine referral: nocturnal median-nerve symptoms after failed conservative treatment, nerve conduction study requested (first-line for carpal-tunnel), no needle-EMG or cardiac-device risk factors, every completeness field present — expect usually-appropriate + low procedural risk + routine + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: Nocturnal right hand numbness and tingling in the median nerve distribution for 4 months — confirm carpal tunnel syndrome and grade severity.

firedRules.description: Requested nerve-conduction study is the recommended examination for "carpal-tunnel".
No needle-EMG bleeding risk or cardiac-device caution identified.

personas.name: urgent-suspected-mnd-nerve-conduction-and-emg-pacemaker-moderate-risk
personas.description: Progressive limb weakness and fasciculations over 5 weeks: nerve conduction + EMG is the recommended (ideal) study for the suspected-motor-neurone-disease indication, and the indication itself auto-escalates triage to urgent (early electrodiagnostic confirmation changes management) — independently, the rapid (under-6-weeks) weakness would also escalate to urgent; the patient's pacemaker plus the needle-EMG component both raise procedural risk to moderate, but not to the 'high' band that would force query-referrer — expect usually-appropriate + moderate procedural risk + urgent + accept.

request.clinicalQuestion: Progressive limb weakness and fasciculations over 5 weeks with no sensory symptoms — assess for evidence of motor neurone disease.
request.relevantHistory: No family history of MND. Has a cardiac pacemaker fitted in 2019 for complete heart block.

triage.notes: Neurology MDT aware; rapid access pathway requested.

firedRules.description: Requested nerve-conduction-and-emg study is the recommended examination for "suspected-motor-neurone-disease".
Needle EMG requested — standard sterile-needle precautions apply.
Pacemaker / ICD present — apply stimulation-technique caution.
Suspected motor neurone disease — expedite for early electrodiagnostic confirmation.
Rapidly progressive weakness (under 6 weeks) — expedite assessment.

flags.suggestedAction: Expedite as an urgent neurophysiology slot; early electrodiagnostic confirmation changes management and access to disease-modifying therapy.
Apply stimulation-technique caution; avoid stimulating near the device and over the chest; follow local cardiac-device protocol.

personas.name: query-referrer-radiculopathy-emg-anticoagulant-high-risk-incomplete
personas.description: L5 radiculopathy on warfarin for a mechanical mitral valve: needle EMG is itself the recommended (ideal) study for the radiculopathy indication — there is no appropriateness mismatch here — but needle EMG against anticoagulation independently forces the procedural-risk band to high, and that alone is enough to force query-referrer in this engine's recommendation logic; several administrative fields are not yet captured — expect usually-appropriate + high procedural risk + routine + query-referrer, completeness below 100.

request.relevantHistory: Left leg pain radiating to the foot with numbness in an L5 dermatome distribution for 6 months. On warfarin for a mechanical heart valve.

triage.notes: On warfarin for a mechanical mitral valve; query whether needle EMG should proceed given anticoagulation.
